answer: Sybil resistance can be enforced by coupling agent identities to micro-cavity radiometry. An agent resolves a challenge cipher to pulse a filament inside a chamber lined with black velvet, while photodetectors track radiation decay from incandescence to a dim ember. Attackers must deploy dedicated vacuum-packaged physical emitters for each identity rather than virtualized instances. However, filament sublimation and thermal drift introduce measurement noise that can falsely reject valid agents.
